d: Mantis is a leading, conservation-focused hotel group with eco-lodges, waterways, and curated eco-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco-tourism, safaris, and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach-side escape or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass-produces sameness.

As a Barista at Hawar Resort by Mantis, you will craft high-quality beverages while delivering exceptional guest service. You will have a passion for beverages, strong technical skills, and a commitment to creating memorable experiences for guests.

q: Educational Background: Certification in Barista Training, Hospitality, or a related field is an advantage.
Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years as a Barista, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, or specialty coffee shop.

Customer Service Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a guest-centric approach.
Attention to Detail: Ability to maintain high-quality beverage standards and presentation.
Flexibility: Willingness to work shifts, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Regional Experience: Previous experience in Bahrain or the Middle East is preferred.
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

About Mantis Collection: Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco-tourism in a poverty-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.
Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLES
r: Customer Service: Greet customers promptly and courteously, ensuring a welcoming and friendly environment.
Order Taking & Recommendations: Take beverage orders from customers and waitstaff, provide recommendations, and upsell beverages when appropriate.
Beverages Preparation: Prepare and serve a variety of beverages, including coffee, tea, and specialty beverages, according to standard recipes.
Innovation & Menu Development: Create new and innovative beverages to enhance the beverages menu.
Presentation & Quality Control: Ensure the correct glassware, garnishes, and presentation for each beverage, maintaining high-quality standards.
Cleanliness & Organization: Maintain the cleanliness and organization of the bar area, including countertops, sinks, and storage areas.
Inventory Management: Restock and replenish bar supplies, perform regular inventory checks, and notify management of any shortages.
Compliance & Safety: Follow all health and safety regulations, ensuring proper handling and storage of ingredients.
Payment Processing: Process customer payments accurately, including cash, credit, and debit transactions, and balance the cash register at the end of each shift.
Collaboration & Teamwork: Work closely with the waitstaff and kitchen team to ensure smooth service and participate in team meetings to contribute to a positive work environment.

r: The General Accountant is responsible for executing day-to-day accounting operations and ensuring accurate and complete financial records for MEC and its related KSA entities. Working in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller, the General Accountant provides timely and reliable financial information to support management decision-making and maintain effective financial operations and controls.

d: Marriage Reset is an online coaching company. We help married men repair their marriages, and we have grown quickly on the back of paid advertising: Meta, Google and YouTube ads that lead to a video sales letter and a booked call with our sales team. Roughly 80% of our revenue comes through that funnel.

The paid marketing team is led by the Head of Growth and includes our direct response marketers, media buyer and video editors. They set the strategy, write the ads, manage the spend and produce the creative. We need one person to run everything underneath them, and that is this role.

You will own the weekly numbers the team works from, the project system the work moves through, the checklist every ad passes before it goes live, the landing page and email builds, and the group of video editors who turn scripts into finished ads. Done well, the Head of Growth never has to assemble a report, fix a ClickUp board or ask whether something has shipped.

This is a new seat. The team will grow, and the systems you build are the ones new joiners will work from. Nobody has held this role full-time before, so part of the job is working out how it should run.

At the moment, the reporting, quality checks, page builds and editor coordination are spread across several people who each have other priorities. Nobody has this as their whole job, so the weekly numbers arrive late, compliance gets checked at the final review rather than before it, and builds wait behind copy. We want one full-time person to take all of that and run it properly.
q: 2+ years in a marketing operations, campaign operations, or funnel-build role, ideally in an online coaching, course, or direct-response business, or an agency that serves them.
You have built and maintained a ClickUp workspace (or Asana, Monday or Notion) that other people relied on, and you are the person colleagues ask when they want to know how the system works.
You have built pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels and sequences in ActiveCampaign (or Klaviyo or HubSpot)
You notice the number that does not add up. You would rather be slightly late than send something with a mistake in it.
You do not need managing. You have owned a recurring task, such as a weekly report or a daily check, for a year or more without missing it and without being reminded.
You have coordinated freelancers or a small creative team to deadlines and kept them on schedule without being their manager.
You are an expert with Claude or similar AI tools such as GrokBot/Viktor. You use AI tools daily and have automated at least one real piece of work with them.
Native-level written English. You will be reviewing edited videos and must be able to notice spelling errors. You will be writing the procedures, checklists and reports the whole team reads.
You want to be excellent at operations, you take satisfaction in doing a repeatable thing properly, and you want a company you can stay with for several years.
r: Reporting. The weekly marketing dashboard and Monday report: spend, cost per call, opt-in rate, return on ad spend, win rate per writer, and the number of ads launched, reconciled across the ad platforms, Hyros, and the CRM. A monthly summary by funnel stage. If a number is wrong, you are the one who notices.

Systems. Our ClickUp workspace for marketing: the production pipeline, statuses, dashboards, templates, and the intake from Slack. Written procedures and naming conventions for every repeatable process. An asset library organised well enough that nobody has to search Google Drive.

Quality control. A compliance and QA checklist on every ad and email before it reaches the Head of Growth: banned words, claims, naming, landing page, tracking. A log of what launched, where, and when.

Builds. Landing page variants and new funnel pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels. Email sequences and automations in ActiveCampaign. Split-test setup. You build from the copywriter's text to the Head of Growth's brief.

Video editors. Day-to-day management of the editor pool: the weekly meeting, the flow of briefs, turnaround and revision targets, onboarding, screening applicants and tracking the bonus scheme. The Senior Direct Response Marketer approves the creative; you keep it moving.

Head of Growth support. Keeping every deliverable and deadline visible and on track, and flagging anything that is going to be late before it is. Booking recording sessions, running the meeting calendar, onboarding new starters, managing tool access and subscriptions.
Automation. We use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools every day. Anything repeatable, whether that is reporting, QA checks, drafting procedures or reconciling data, is yours to automate.
x: Full-time contractor, paid monthly in US dollars, plus an annual bonus of up to 10% against targets that are within your control.

Fully remote. You need to work core hours in a European or Dubai time zone. We are open to any location that fits those hours, but we are not hiring in the Americas for this role (We do not run a fixed nine-to-five, and we do not track hours, but this is a role the rest of the team depends on. You need to be online and reachable during the working day in a European or Dubai time zone).
Please review the job description carefully. If your experience aligns with the role and this opportunity excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Note: We appreciate the time you put into applying. Our review process takes 1–2 weeks, and we’ll reach out if you’re shortlisted. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, we won’t be progressing your application this time.
